batting.description: Batting Pressure Score measures a player's ability to perform in high-stakes situations on a 0-100 scale.

components.name: Death Over Strike Rate
components.description: Strike rate in overs 17-20. Higher SR = better finisher.

components.name: Chase Performance
components.description: Strike rate and impact when batting second in run chases.

components.name: Close Match Impact
components.description: Runs per innings and SR in matches decided by ≤15 runs or ≤2 wickets.

components.name: Pressure Consistency
components.description: Batting average in all pressure situations (death overs + close matches + late chases).

components.name: Win Contribution
components.description: Percentage of matches won when the player batted.

components.name: Sample Size
components.description: Bonus for larger sample of matches (up to 50 matches for full credit).

batting.pressure_situations: Death overs (17-20), close matches (≤15 runs or ≤2 wickets margin), 2nd innings overs 16-20.

bowling.description: Bowling Pressure Score measures a bowler's effectiveness in high-pressure situations on a 0-100 scale.

components.name: Death Over Economy
components.description: Economy rate in overs 17-20. Lower economy = more restrictive.

components.name: Death Over Wickets
components.description: Wicket-taking rate at death. Higher = more impactful.

components.name: Close Match Economy
components.description: Economy rate in close matches. Lower = more clutch.

components.name: Pressure Dot Ball %
components.description: Percentage of dot balls in pressure situations.

components.name: Win Contribution
components.description: Percentage of matches won when the player bowled.

components.name: Sample Size
components.description: Bonus for larger sample of matches.

bowling.pressure_situations: Death overs (17-20), close matches, defending in 2nd innings death overs.
